fusions.name: Rigging Swing
fusions.desc: Swings in on a line to kick an enemy up to 6 tiles away, dealing 13 damage that grows the further it reaches, up to 1.6 times at full reach, and knocking it back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Overboard Cargo
fusions.desc: Heaves 3 crates at once, spread apart, each dealing 26 damage. Each one explodes on impact, dealing 80% of its damage to every enemy within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Mast-Top Lookout
fusions.desc: Climbs high to see the whole field: for 20 seconds your attacks and spells reach 30% further.

fusions.name: Rolling Gait
fusions.desc: Your movement speed is permanently increased by 8%, and you carry 8% water resistance.
